name: Dan Osborn
summary:
Daniel L. Osborn (born March 29, 1975) is an American veteran, labor union leader and independent politician from Nebraska. After serving in the United States Navy, Osborn joined the Nebraska Army National Guard. 
While working at Kellogg's as an industrial mechanic, he became president of Bakery, Confectionery, Tobacco Workers and Grain Millers International Union Local 50G and led the strike at Kellogg's Omaha plant in 2021.
